{{Quote|We underestimated his power. When we confronted him, he didn't even have to fight us. Instead, he broke our wills. He dominated our minds, turning us into puppets to do his bidding. He sent us back to the Republic as the vanguard of his invasion.|[[Revan/Legends|Revan]]|<ref name="Revan" />}}
In [[3960 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] followed the trail of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] from [[Nathema]] to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|True Sith Empire]], and embarked on a months-long '''mission''' in order to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Emperor. Posing as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to gain the confidence of the [[Imperial Guard]] [[Yarri]], but the Guardsman deceived them and led the two into a trap where the Emperor [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|dominated their wills]]. Turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and anointed as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan and Darth Malak,<ref name="Revan" /> the two new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] were ordered to [[Search for the Star Maps|seek out the Star Forge]]<ref name="T8" /> and to [[Jedi Civil War|wage war]] upon the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], though they broke free of the Emperor's control not long afterwards<ref name="Revan" /> and decided to seek out the [[Star Forge]] for themselves.<ref name="T8" />
